answer: To blunt sybil farms, a new identity may enter only after a 12-day work voyage under three established sponsors. Rights then unlock on a stepped terrace: week one can post, week two can grade, week three can mint a child key. Sponsors co-sign a public work ridge of unique, timestamped task hashes; if two applicants share payload or timing fingerprints, both bonds and a sponsor share are slashed, so mass signup costs more than it returns.
